text: # minimax-c1-p90-sa: the pinned MiniMax M3.1 Flash checkpoint (native DSpark draft in its dspark/ subdir) and the uncapped
# 062126 trace corpus into one HF cache on the node's NVMe (refs/main = the pins, for offline loads). No HF download in
# the normal case: the model is copied from the shared read-only cache /mnt/hf_cache (refs/main there = the pin, checked
# 2026-11-14) and the corpus from /shared_nfs/huggingface/hub. Fallback, only if /mnt/hf_cache is not mounted on this
# node or lacks the pin: snapshot_download at the pin (HF token on the node host only, never in a container).
# Every step verifies: refs/main = pin, every shard the index names resolves, size equal to the source.
. /shared_nfs/qiangh/mywork/arbor_dsv41flash/experiments/minimax-c1-p90-sa/env.sh   # absolute: frozen copies run from logs/
log "start on $(hostname -s); hub $HUB_NL; NVMe free: $(df -h --output=avail "$(dirname "$HUB_NL")" | tail -1)"
log "model already staged at the pin"
[ "$free" -gt $(( need + 50*1024*1024 )) ] || die "NVMe free ${free} KB < model ${need} KB + 50 GB"
log "copying $SRC ($(( need / 1024 / 1024 )) GB) from the shared cache (blobs + snapshot symlinks, as is)"
log "WARNING $SRC does not hold the pin (refs/main: $(cat "$SRC/refs/main" 2>/dev/null || echo none)); falling back to snapshot_download"

[ -x "$PYDL" ] || { python3 -m venv "$(dirname "$HUB_NL")/dlvenv" && "$(dirname "$HUB_NL")/dlvenv/bin/pip" -q install huggingface_hub hf_xet && PYDL=$(dirname "$HUB_NL")/dlvenv/bin/python; } || die "dl venv"
print("[dl]", snapshot_download(repo, revision=rev, cache_dir=hub, max_workers=16), flush=True)
# ---- verify the model: refs/main, every shard of both indexes (main + dspark/) resolves ------------------
d, rev, want_n = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], int(sys.argv[3])
assert open(os.path.join(d, "refs", "main")).read().strip() == rev, "refs/main is not the pin"
idx = [f for f in os.listdir(p) if f.endswith(".safetensors.index.json")]
missing = [s for s in shards if not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(p, s))]
assert not missing, f"{sub or 'main'}: missing {missing[:5]}"
size = sum(os.path.getsize(os.path.join(p, s)) for s in shards)
print(f"[dl] {sub or 'main'}: {len(shards)} shards resolve, {size/2**30:.1f} GiB", flush=True)
assert len(shards) == want_n, f"main has {len(shards)} shards, expected {want_n}"
print(f"[dl] model ok @ {rev[:10]}: {total/2**30:.1f} GiB of shards", flush=True)
[ "$a" = "$b" ] || die "staged snapshot is $b bytes, the shared cache has $a"
log "staged snapshot size equals the shared cache: $b bytes"
# Only the cache's data dirs: trees/ there holds another user's mode-600 metadata file (2026-11-14), which we
# cannot read and the loader does not need.
for d in blobs refs snapshots .no_exist; do
# Smoke and before/after measurements for minimax-c1-p90-sa: full AgentX at C1 and GSM8K, on a fresh server. Serves the
# tree in the container exactly as Arbor builds the launch (arbor/frameworks/vllm.py: vllm serve <model_path>
# server_env with ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<gpu_ids> and no HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES: arbor/frameworks/base.py:121-129), runs the
# pack's bench_agentx.sh (the AgentX replay, DURATION s), then GSM8K with InferenceX's run_lm_eval (lm-eval,
# infx/evals/gsm8k.yaml, 5-shot; the same tool as Kimi K3.1 Pro); stops that server (its own process group only).
# Adapted from experiments/musespark-c1-p90-sa/ab.sh (the proven pattern) and dsv41f-c1-p90-sa2/ab.sh (the vLLM parts).
# (timeout wraps bash, not run_lm_eval: timeout cannot run a shell function -- smoke 2026-11-14, rc=127)
# usage: bash ab.sh <tag> <duration_s> <gsm8k_questions>      e.g.  before 3600 1319 | after 3600 1319 | smoke 600 100
. /shared_nfs/qiangh/mywork/arbor_dsv41flash/experiments/minimax-c1-p90-sa/env.sh   # absolute: frozen copies run from logs/
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "curl -sf -m 3 localhost:$PORT/health >/dev/null" && die "a server already answers on port $PORT"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT log -1 --format='tree %H %s'; git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT status --porcelain --untracked-files=no | head -20" > "$OUT_H/tree.txt"
AB_CONFIG=${AB_CONFIG:-$CONFIG}   # after.sh passes the kept launch (server_env/server_flags from the session)
cfg, envf, serve, gpus, port, dur, outc = sys.argv[1:8]
env = dict(c["server_env"]); env["DURATION"] = dur; env["ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = gpus
for k, v in env.items(): f.write(f"export {k}={shlex.quote(v)}\n")
names = mn if mp in ("", mn) else f"{mn} {mp}"
log "$TAG: tree $(head -1 "$OUT_H/tree.txt" | cut -c1-80); server on GPUs $GPUS port $PORT; AgentX ${DUR}s; GSM8K $NQ"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" pgrep -f "[v]llm serve .*--port $PORT " >/dev/null || { log "$TAG: FATAL server died"; tail -40 "$OUT_H/server.log"; exit 1; }
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "curl -sf -m 5 localhost:$PORT/health >/dev/null" || { log "$TAG: FATAL not healthy after 60 min"; tail -30 "$OUT_H/server.log"; exit 1; }
grep -aE "non-default args|[Uu]sing .*backend|dspark|DSpark|[Mm]ono" "$OUT_H/server.log" | head -12 | cut -c1-300 | sed "s/^/[ab] $TAG server: /"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "pid=\$(pgrep -f '[v]llm serve .*--port $PORT ' | head -1); [ -n \"\$pid\" ] && kill -TERM -- -\$(ps -o pgid= -p \$pid | tr -d ' ') 2>/dev/null; sleep 30; \
for p in \$(pgrep -f 'VLLM|vllm'); do grep -qa 'ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$GPUS' /proc/\$p/environ 2>/dev/null && kill -9 \$p; done; true"
# A quick sanity request first: the reply, the reasoning split and the DSpark acceptance counters.

log "$TAG: sanity reply: $(python3 -c "import json,sys; m=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['choices'][0]['message']; print(repr((m.get('content') or '')[:80]), 'reasoning', len(m.get('reasoning_content') or m.get('reasoning') or ''), 'chars')" "$OUT_H/sanity.json" 2>&1 | tail -1)"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c ". $OUT_C/server.env; export PORT=$PORT MODEL_PATH=$MODEL_ID MODEL_NAME=$MODEL_ID CONCURRENCY=1 NUM_PROMPTS=320 \
log "$TAG: AgentX rc=$? after $(( $(date +%s) - T1 )) s: $(grep -a '^\[bench_agentx\] p90_intvty' "$OUT_H/bench.log" | tail -1)"
# The bench reads the corpus with the Hub online (as CI): record the revision the cache holds (the pin is 23f152f6).
except Exception as e: sys.exit(f"[ab] no bench_output.json: {e}")
print(f"[ab] DSpark mean acceptance length (1 + accepted/drafts, whole server life): {1 + acc / drafts:.2f}")
docker exec $LIMIT -e PORT="$PORT" -e MODEL="$MODEL_ID" -e MODEL_NAME="$MODEL_ID" -e EVAL_MAX_MODEL_LEN=16384 \
"$CONTAINER" timeout 10800 bash -c "cd /workspace/InferenceX && source benchmarks/benchmark_lib.sh && run_lm_eval --port $PORT --task infx/evals/gsm8k.yaml --results-dir $OUT_C/gsm8k" \
log "$TAG: GSM8K ($NQ) rc=$? after $(( $(date +%s) - T2 )) s"
print("[ab] no gsm8k results_*.json found"); sys.exit(0)
print(f"[ab] gsm8k n={n} " + ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in r.items() if "exact_match" in k))
# Provision the node for minimax-c1-p90-sa. Idempotent; run on the GPU node through ctrl/, after dl.sh. Adapted from
# experiments/musespark-c1-p90-sa/prepare.sh (proven over a 24 h campaign) with the vLLM parts of dsv41f-c1-p90-sa2. Steps:
#   1. node checks: docker, GPUs idle, other users' containers listed (never touched)
#   2. the CI image by digest (anonymous pull if needed), tagged, digest verified
#   3. Arbor v0.9.2-baseline-test from the archive (sha256 checked; plain tree + a local git commit), the heartbeat patch
#      as a second local commit, our pack (stock agentx validator/tools/knowledge + our pack.yaml and the
#      e2e_norm_intvty-patched bench_agentx.sh) and config; Arbor's own pack/campaign validation
#   5. the HF cache on NVMe (dl.sh): model at its pin, every shard resolving; the corpus
#   6. the container: the NVMe hub at /hf-hub (and as the default HF cache), InferenceX, Arbor, sessions, the experiment
#   7. stack versions; the vLLM package tree as a git repository (Arbor's workspace_root); aiter as an editable package
#   8. the aiperf environment for the bench (InferenceX's install_agentic_deps)
#   9. ruppell for the profiler skill (not fatal)
. /shared_nfs/qiangh/mywork/arbor_dsv41flash/experiments/minimax-c1-p90-sa/env.sh   # absolute: frozen copies run from logs/
docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "no working docker daemon"
docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}} {{.Status}}' | grep -v "^$CONTAINER " | sed 's/^/[prepare] other container (not ours, not touched): /'
[ "${vram:-0}" -le 1 ] || die "a GPU is in use before start"
case "$digests" in *"$IMAGE_DIGEST"*) log "image ok: $IMAGE_TAG = $IMAGE_DIGEST";; *) die "image digest mismatch or missing: '$digests'";; esac
git -C "$ARBOR" init -q && git -C "$ARBOR" -c user.email=qh@local -c user.name=qh add -A \
&& git -C "$ARBOR" -c user.email=qh@local -c user.name=qh commit -q -m "AMD-AGI/Arbor v0.9.2-baseline-test $ARBOR_SHA (archive)" || die "Arbor git"
# The same local fix as musespark-c1-p90-sa's 3a404ad: the bench prompt's Monitor watch prints a heartbeat.
&& git -C "$ARBOR" -c user.email=qh@local -c user.name=qh commit -q -am "local fix: the bench prompt's Monitor watch prints a heartbeat (the CLI ends a Monitor silent for 10 min)" \
grep -q 'sleep 30; echo waiting; done' "$ARBOR/arbor/policy/claude_loop.py" || die "heartbeat patch missing"
log "pack $PACK and config $CONFIG_REL installed (bench_agentx.sh = the e2e_norm_intvty-patched version)"
python3 -m venv "$VENV" && "$PY" -m pip install -q --upgrade pip && "$PY" -m pip install -q pyyaml claude-agent-sdk || die "venv"
# Arbor's own checks of the pack and the campaign config (arbor/pack/loader.py).
( cd "$ARBOR" && PYTHONPATH="$ARBOR" "$PY" - "$CONFIG_REL" <<'PY' ) || die "Arbor rejects the pack or config"
from arbor.pack.loader import load_campaign, validate_campaign, validate_pack
# The stock agentx pack's own tools/ draws "unrecognized directory: tools/" (the stock pack does too); the driver refuses
# on validation only in component mode (arbor/driver.py:354), so in standalone it is known and accepted. Anything else fails.
for e in errors: print(f"[prepare] arbor validation: {e}")
[ -n "$(find -L "$HUB_NL/$MODEL_DIR/snapshots/$MODEL_REV/dspark" -name '*.safetensors' -type f | head -1)" ] || die "no dspark draft shard"
render=$(getent group render | cut -d: -f3); video=$(getent group video | cut -d: -f3)
# aiperf's subprocesses ignore an HF_HUB_CACHE override (Kimi K3.1 Pro, 2026-11-13): make the default cache the NVMe hub.
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c 'mkdir -p /root/.cache/huggingface && ln -sfn /hf-hub /root/.cache/huggingface/hub' || die "hf cache link"
[ "$n" -eq "$MODEL_SHARDS" ] || die "$n/$MODEL_SHARDS shards resolve in the container"
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download as s
p = s('$MODEL_ID', local_files_only=True); print('[prepare] offline resolve:', p)
assert p.endswith('$MODEL_REV')" || die "the repo id does not resolve offline to the pin in the container"
python3 -c "import vllm, torch; print(\"vllm:\", vllm.__version__, vllm.__file__); print(\"torch:\", torch.__version__, torch.version.hip)"
VLLM_DIR=$(docker exec "$CONTAINER" python3 -c 'import os, vllm; print(os.path.dirname(vllm.__file__))' 2>/dev/null | tail -1)
[ "$VLLM_DIR" = "$WORKSPACE_ROOT" ] || die "vllm is at $VLLM_DIR, not $WORKSPACE_ROOT (fix env.sh and config.json)"
# Arbor's has_changes needs workspace_root to be a git repository (Kimi K3.1 Pro gotcha 1): commit the package as shipped.
git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo repo present at \$(git rev-parse --short HEAD); exit 0; }
git init -q . && git config user.email arbor@local && git config user.name Arbor && git config core.fileMode false
git add -A 2>/dev/null && git commit -q -m \"baseline: vllm as shipped in $IMAGE_TAG@$IMAGE_DIGEST\"
echo initialised \$(git ls-files | wc -l) files at \$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
docker exec "$CONTAINER" git -C "$WORKSPACE_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "vllm tree is not a git repository"
pk = [e for e in cfg.get("editable_packages", []) if e.get("name") != "aiter"]
r = subprocess.run(["docker", "exec", c, "python3", "-c", "import os, aiter; print(os.path.dirname(aiter.__file__))"],
path = r.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1] if r.returncode == 0 and r.stdout.strip() else ""
if [ -x "${AIPERF_CLI:-}" ] && [ -f "$AIPERF_RUNTIME_DIR/.ready" ]; then echo "aiperf present"; exit 0; fi
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c 'test -f /root/inferencex-agentic/.ready' || die "aiperf environment not ready"
|| log "WARNING InferenceX not clean at $INFX_SHA: $(git -C "$INFX" rev-parse --short HEAD) $(git -C "$INFX" status --porcelain | head -3 | tr '\n' ' ')"
